description: This Go source file defines the MCPHandler struct and its methods to handle MCP-related HTTP operations within a web server, including health checks, server restarts, tool retrieval, status reporting, event streaming, and metrics for MCPs in a system managed via Gin framework routes.

classes.name: MCPHandler
classes.description: Handler struct providing MCP-related HTTP route handlers, encapsulating dependencies on services and external interfaces.

methods.name: GetMCPHealthHandler
methods.description: Handles requests for detailed or summary MCP health information based on mode parameter.

methods.name: RestartMCPServerHandler
methods.description: Processes requests to restart a specific MCP server; only allowed in developer mode.

methods.name: GetMCPToolsHandler
methods.description: Retrieves tools from a specified MCP server, restricted to developer mode.

methods.name: GetMCPStatusHandler
methods.description: Provides overall MCP status across system nodes, including detailed info in developer mode.

methods.name: GetMCPEventsHandler
methods.description: Establishes a Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream for MCP event notifications, maintaining connection with heartbeat messages.

methods.name: GetMCPMetricsHandler
methods.description: Placeholder endpoint returning MCP metrics; currently unimplemented.
